headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Pak govt forms committee to oversee affairs of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
El Niño Threatens Telangana with Severe Drought; Temperatures May Touch 50°C.
Madras High Court quashes money laundering proceedings against former DMK Minister Ponmudy.
bullets_ur: Pak hukumat ne Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ke mamlaat ki nigraani ke liye committee qaim kar di.
El Nino ki wajah se Telangana ko shadeed khushk-sali ka khatra, darja-e-hararat 50°C tak ja sakta hai.
Madras High Court ne sabaq dosh DMK Minister Ponmudy ke khilaf money laundering karwai khatam kar di.
